coverage.target: ADR-014 — BOTH _LENS_QUERY and _SUMMARY_QUERY gain `decision = 'accepted'` predicates. The columns alone grant nothing; the queries that read them are where the exposure closes.
Two independent enum columns, one per link [ADR-009]
`declined` is a stored state, so re-adding the number finds it rather than creating a fresh pending link [ADR-009]
The declined→accepted transition is permitted on the column; InvitationLens is granted on `declined` as well as `pending` so the person can reach the seat [ADR-009, ADR-011]
No teacher-reachable path writes the column. Enforced at the API layer rather than by the schema, and recorded here so Functional Design does not have to rediscover it [ADR-009]
InvitationLens carries enrollment_id and reaches batch name, subject and fee — all teacher-authored, so no privacy boundary is crossed [ADR-011]
A fourth Lens subtype [ADR-011], resolved by its own statement rather than a branch of _LENS_QUERY, because an invitation grant is per-enrollment and a person may hold several
`pending` is a durable column value with no expiry mechanism, so a seat stays pending indefinitely [ADR-009]
The roster reads both decision columns; `pending` and `declined` are distinguishable values rather than inferred absences [ADR-009]
Removal while unaccepted is expressible as `both links not accepted`, which the enum makes a direct predicate [ADR-009]
Signup creates Account, Profile, and an Owner row only for the Teacher choice. No role column [ADR-010]
Both decision columns are independent, so one account holding both links on one seat carries two values and sees the seat once [ADR-009]
Profile.address, nullable text, under the existing row-level-security policy; the display name is Profile.self_name and needs no column [ADR-010]
The decision column survives the erasure marker being set, and the two compose to mean 'declined, then left' [ADR-009, ADR-012]
InvitationLens plus the two decision columns [ADR-009, ADR-011]
Profile populated at signup [ADR-010]
The already-added path reads the pending link and pre-fills Enrollment.display_name; signing up does not change the decision column [ADR-009, ADR-010]
The declined→accepted transition and the InvitationLens grant on `declined` [ADR-009, ADR-011]
Both values readable per link on the roster [ADR-009]
The three role lenses stay one statement; the invitation read is a second statement issued only on the invitation route, so the per-request path is unchanged [ADR-011]
No cached summary and no denormalised count: the roster's accepted count is computed from the columns [ADR-009]
No eager per-lens data at login is a behaviour of the login response rather than of the schema. Nothing in this stage changes it.

reverse.target: FR1.9b, FR1.9a, FR1.9c, FR1.9e, FR1.9h, FR1.9i, FR1.16 — per-link acceptance as two enum columns
FR1.17, FR1.7a, US1.11 — signup's personal data on Profile, under the existing row-level-security policy
FR1.9d, FR1.9d.1, NFR20 — InvitationLens as a fourth type in the existing hierarchy
FR11.1a, and the governance obligation under ADR-004 — a declined seat keeps the teacher-typed name, and the manifest discloses it
FR1.9b — the guardian link's state, independent of the student's
FR1.17 — owner-private, HARD_DELETE / LIFE_OF_ACCOUNT by Profile's existing manifest entry
FR1.9d.1 — the lens a pending read resolves

FR1.9a, FR1.9e — the acceptance backfill. A plain DEFAULT 'pending' would have retroactively withdrawn the student lens from every seat whose student had already signed in, because is_dormant is student_account_id IS NULL and signing in was acceptance under the superseded model.
FR1.9a, FR1.4a — both lens-granting queries filter on the decision columns. Without it the columns exist and nothing reads them, leaving the mistyped-number exposure open.
